statement.canonical: The Kyiv mayor's official account stated in a 5 August update that fifteen people had been reported injured and nine remained in city hospitals.

assessment.rationale: The exact nine-of-fifteen wording belongs to Telegram post 7134 and is timestamped by Kyiv's official portal on 19 July 2026, not 5 August. The publication-event claim is withdrawn from 5 August reporting.

statement.canonical: Fifteen people were injured and nine remained hospitalized after the overnight Kyiv attack discussed in the 5 August municipal update.

assessment.rationale: The only frozen observation with these figures is now correctly assigned to the 19 July attack chronology. It cannot support an object-level casualty claim for the overnight 4/5 August event.

statement.canonical: The Guardian attributed to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticism that air-defence deliveries had been delayed.

assessment.rationale: The frozen Guardian-derived observation records this attribution. Confidence is medium because the page was later edited and no immutable article artifact was stored.

statement.canonical: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticized delays in air-defence deliveries.

assessment.rationale: A Guardian article attributed the criticism to the president, but the underlying presidential post or transcript was not separately frozen.

statement.canonical: The Guardian attributed to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy a request for additional air-defence support.

assessment.rationale: The frozen Guardian-derived observation records this attribution. Confidence is medium because no immutable article artifact was stored and the page was later edited.

statement.canonical: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy requested additional air-defence support.

assessment.rationale: A Guardian article attributed the request to the president, but no separate primary presidential publication was frozen.

statement.canonical: The Guardian attributed to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy a request for additional sanctions.

assessment.rationale: The frozen Guardian-derived observation records this attribution. Confidence is medium because the underlying primary post and an immutable article artifact were not stored.
